about_item: ULTIMATE OUTDOOR HALLOWEEN DECOR:Transform your yard into a haunted paradise! These 2 light up ghost outdoor decorations create spooky-fun ambiance for porch ghost displays or halloween yard decorations outdoor. Their glowing presence captivates trick-or-treaters as floating ghost silhouettes in the dark.

SMART REMOTE STRING LIGHTS & TIMER:Control halloween ghosts outdoor effortlessly! Remote features 8 lighting modes + auto timer (6hrs off/18hrs on). They can add a magical touch to spooky ghosts. Perfect for lit ghosts for porch displays without manual intervention.

CUSTOMIZABLE GHOST PERSONALITIES:Design unique ghost halloween decorations! Interchange several faces & witch hats to create playful porch ghosts. Endless fun for halloween patio decor!Place spooky ghost decorations with string lights in the corners of your room, outdoors in the yard, and on your doorstep to create the perfect Halloween atmosphere.

EASY ASSEMBLY:Secure ghost decorations outside with U-stakes.or Other Heavy objects on the base of the tripod. Adjustable standing ghost up to 60 in! Assemble the Halloween ghost decorations according to the instructions, it is very strong, no worries about being blown over due to wind, create a spectacular display with ease.

PERFECT OUTDOOR DECORATION: When the assembled spooky ghosts are placed outdoors, they will be the highlight of the whole party, adding a sense of mystery and horror to your party that will amaze every visiting guest.
VERSATILE SPOOKY ACCENT:Perfect for yard ghosts halloween, haunted houses or parties! Use as outdoor light up ghost or indoor ghost decoration. The best halloween decorations multi-scene solution!

summary.text: Customers find the Halloween decorations easy to set up and appreciate their quality, with the ghosts receiving positive feedback. The lighting and remote control features receive mixed reviews - while they light up well and the remote control is handy, some report that one set of lights doesn't work and the remote stops functioning after two weeks of use. Moreover, the stability is a concern as they fall over daily, and customers disagree on whether they're suitable for outdoor use. Value for money opinions are divided between those who find it worth the price and those who say it's not worth the money.

authors_reviews.title: Great Halloween product!
authors_reviews.text: I have a Halloween addiction and this item was prefect. Set up was easy. As a bonus everything needed for the set up was included. Love the way it looks. Super satisfied with the product. I think anyone who orders will be glad they did.
authors_reviews.author: Daniel Burdette

authors_reviews.title: Great customer service
authors_reviews.text: I had an issue with these ghosts, but the company quickly made it right. These are cute, and my daughter loves them. I have these on my porch, and they did fall over in the wind since I couldn't secure the tripod with the included stakes. I got a set of water weights meant for balloon displays that I've added which has solved the problem. My only wish is that the fabric for the ghosts was a square or even a circle, as it can be tricky to drape the rectangle fabric nicely, and that there was a way to secure it to the pole.
authors_reviews.author: Kelsey

authors_reviews.text: Cute little things! Easy to put together, light up nicely. my remote does not work properly, it turns them off and thats it. They do tip over very easily, unless secured in the grass or ground. I only have a hard surface, so I used water jugs to secure them.
authors_reviews.author: Chamblie

authors_reviews.title: Pitiful quality- needs a lot of work for a $30-35 product.
authors_reviews.text: Firstly, most of the product pictures are AI, and look nothing like the actual ghosts.The sheets are AWFUL:1, They're jagged and uneven so no matter what the tripod will be visible on at least one side2, They're so thin so you can see the ball and tripod through them3, There's not even a way to secure the sheet to the base underneath, as if it won't fall off loosely draped over a plastic ball?4, There's a nasty film on them that made my hands feel disgustingNow for the base parts:The fairy lights- there's not really a way to make them look good because it's just a bunch of separate little light spots inside the head. The instructions are bare minimum, no pictures or steps, I just had to figure it out myself. And lastly, the tripod is held together by plastic nobs and closures, I felt like I was breaking it every time I adjusted the height- but hey, it comes with stakes at least, that's SOMETHING.Now for accessories: The eyes and mouth are literally just foam stickers.... stickers don't stick well to fabric- I highly doubt they'd last long. The witch hats come with one safety pin each, like that'll keep the whole thing together. Yes, I'm sure most people have extra pins lying around, but for $30 I expect the product to be self-sufficient.The whole thing overall is sooooo flimsy and weak, I find it hilarious they think it would survive outside- one gust of wind and these ghosts would be a pile on the ground. Maybe worth 10 bucks max, anyone could make their own ghosts way better for cheaper.
authors_reviews.author: BitterSweet

authors_reviews.title: More sturdy than last year’s model
authors_reviews.text: More sturdy than last year’s model. Easy to assemble. Looks cute near my front door!
authors_reviews.author: Ewa

authors_reviews.title: Such a great quality item. They thought of everything
authors_reviews.text: These are so perfect! They're such a quality product. They thought of everything. The two tripods are great. You can raise them to different heights and it has a remote control so you can turn them on and off and change the lights to flash it if you'd like and they fold up and pack away so easily. I love this decoration
authors_reviews.author: Holly Oglesby

authors_reviews.title: Not for outdoor use
authors_reviews.text: Not for outdoor use. These have got to be the flimsiest things I have ever seen. The quality is very poor. To add to that, the stand is not even made to be staked to the ground. It’s a stand for a camera or something. I put them out and the damn sheet became a sail instantly. Which made it impossible to keep them standing up. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY.
authors_reviews.author: Andrew
